svg.text: Rules are pure modules in packages/protocol/src/games (init · reduce · tick · view). The room only stores state and runs them.
Tall tale → First impressions → Left for you
every poll → module.tick(state, now) for timers
view(seat) only shows that seat's secrets
Next game / Again / Finish are votes: both must agree
the glasses poll as that seat;
opened this room when it locked the pair
and put { code, seat } in match.found
Polling (not sockets) because WebSockets on the glasses browser are unconfirmed; the code is the only key.
Every module is tested in packages/protocol/test (tale, impressions, trivia, votes).
Demo pacing (Kenny): First impressions 2 rounds, Left for you 2 questions; ~2.5 minutes in all.
